# Schema diagram

<!-- Generated by `python -m src diagram` from schema/*.json; edit those, not this. The tests fail if it is stale. -->

12 functions, 7 plates and 15 quantities. GitHub draws the diagrams below; in VS Code the Markdown preview needs a Mermaid extension. [`diagram.html`](diagram.html), beside this file, draws the same schema interactively: open it in a browser.

## Functions: what can connect to what

Each function is a table. Its output (PK) is the BN node it defines, one per row of its plate; its inputs (FK) are the nodes it reads. A link joins an output to every input of the same quantity on the same plate; where several hazard functions feed one input, they are alternatives, and an assembly binds one.

Link ends, producer left, consumer right: `||--||` one parent, the same row · `||--o{` many nodes share one parent · `}o--||` many parents per node · `}o--o{` every node of the plate is a parent.

```mermaid
erDiagram
    groundfailure_landslide {
        PGD_Landslide pgd PK "output, one node per GroundFailure"
        PGV pgv FK "input from GroundFailure via self"
        PGA pga FK "input from GroundFailure via self"
        fixed x0 "GroundFailure.x0"
        fixed slope_deg "GroundFailure.slope_deg"
        fixed length_km "GroundFailure.length_km"
        fixed ac_g "GroundFailure.ac_g"
        theta parameters "inline, in each assembly that binds it"
        hazard role "stochastic, Marginal"
    }
    groundfailure_liquefaction {
        PGD_Liquefaction pgd PK "output, one node per GroundFailure"
        PGV pgv FK "input from GroundFailure via self"
        PGA pga FK "input from GroundFailure via self"
        fixed x0 "GroundFailure.x0"
        fixed length_km "GroundFailure.length_km"
        fixed liq_class "GroundFailure.liq_class"
        fixed dw_km "GroundFailure.dw_km"
        theta parameters "inline, in each assembly that binds it"
        hazard role "stochastic, Marginal"
    }
    hazard_fault_rupture {
        PGD_FaultOffset pgd PK "output, one node per GroundFailure"
        fixed lat "GroundFailure.lat"
        fixed lon "GroundFailure.lon"
        fixed slip_type "GroundFailure.slip_type"
        fixed fault_id "GroundFailure.fault_id"
        theta parameters "inline, in each assembly that binds it"
        hazard role "stochastic, Marginal"
    }
    hazard_gmm {
        by_imt im PK "output, one node per Bridge"
        fixed lat "Bridge.lat"
        fixed lon "Bridge.lon"
        table Event "whole table, fixed"
        theta parameters "2 set(s) in instances/hazard"
        hazard role "stochastic, Joint"
    }
    hazard_shakemap {
        by_imt im PK "output, one node per Bridge"
        fixed lat "Bridge.lat"
        fixed lon "Bridge.lon"
        theta parameters "inline, in each assembly that binds it"
        hazard role "stochastic, Joint"
    }
    hazard_shakemap_ground {
        by_imt im PK "output, one node per GroundFailure"
        fixed lat "GroundFailure.lat"
        fixed lon "GroundFailure.lon"
        theta parameters "inline, in each assembly that binds it"
        hazard role "stochastic, Joint"
    }
    observation_intensity {
        by_observed observed PK "output, one node per Bridge"
        by_imt im FK "input from Bridge via self"
        theta parameters "1 set(s) in instances/observation"
        observation role "stochastic, Marginal"
    }
    fragility_bridge {
        by_damage_scale damage PK "output, one node per Bridge"
        by_imt im FK "input from Bridge via self"
        theta parameters "28 set(s) in instances/fragility"
        fragility role "stochastic, Marginal"
    }
    fragility_road {
        by_open open PK "output, one node per GroundFailure"
        by_pgd pgd FK "input from GroundFailure via self"
        theta parameters "8 set(s) in instances/fragility"
        fragility role "stochastic, Marginal"
    }
    edge_open {
        EdgeOpen open PK "output, one node per Edge"
        by_damage_scale damage FK "input from Bridge via Bridge.edge"
        RoadOpen_Liquefaction liquefaction FK "input from GroundFailure via GroundFailure.edge"
        RoadOpen_Landslide landslide FK "input from GroundFailure via GroundFailure.edge"
        RoadOpen_FaultRupture fault FK "input from GroundFailure via GroundFailure.edge"
        table Bridge "whole table, fixed"
        table GroundFailure "whole table, fixed"
        theta parameters "2 set(s) in instances/edge"
        edge role "deterministic, Marginal"
    }
    system_reachable {
        SystemState state PK "output, one node per Support"
        EdgeOpen open FK "input from Edge via *"
        fixed origin "Support.origin"
        table Node "whole table, fixed"
        table Edge "whole table, fixed"
        system role "deterministic, Joint"
    }
    system_travel_time_to_nearest {
        SystemState state PK "output, one node per Node"
        EdgeOpen open FK "input from Edge via *"
        table Node "whole table, fixed"
        table Edge "whole table, fixed"
        table SystemEvent "whole table, fixed"
        system role "deterministic, Joint"
    }
    hazard_shakemap_ground ||--|| groundfailure_landslide : "PGV"
    hazard_shakemap_ground ||--|| groundfailure_landslide : "PGA"
    hazard_shakemap_ground ||--|| groundfailure_liquefaction : "PGV"
    hazard_shakemap_ground ||--|| groundfailure_liquefaction : "PGA"
    hazard_gmm ||--|| observation_intensity : "{imt}"
    hazard_shakemap ||--|| observation_intensity : "{imt}"
    hazard_gmm ||--|| fragility_bridge : "{imt}"
    hazard_shakemap ||--|| fragility_bridge : "{imt}"
    groundfailure_landslide ||--|| fragility_road : "{pgd}"
    groundfailure_liquefaction ||--|| fragility_road : "{pgd}"
    hazard_fault_rupture ||--|| fragility_road : "{pgd}"
    fragility_bridge }o--|| edge_open : "{damage_scale} via Bridge.edge"
    fragility_road }o--|| edge_open : "RoadOpen.Liquefaction via GroundFailure.edge"
    fragility_road }o--|| edge_open : "RoadOpen.Landslide via GroundFailure.edge"
    fragility_road }o--|| edge_open : "RoadOpen.FaultRupture via GroundFailure.edge"
    edge_open }o--o{ system_reachable : "EdgeOpen via *"
    edge_open }o--o{ system_travel_time_to_nearest : "EdgeOpen via *"
```

## Plates: the tables functions are replicated over

Attributes are fixed data, never BN nodes. Foreign keys are what an input's `via` follows.

```mermaid
erDiagram
    Event {
        string id PK "singleton: its variables are global"
        number mw "Mw, optional"
        number lat "deg, optional"
        number lon "deg, optional"
        number depth_km "km, optional"
        string description "optional"
    }
    Node {
        string id PK
        number lat "deg"
        number lon "deg"
        number population "persons, optional"
        string name "optional"
        boolean key_destination
    }
    Edge {
        string id PK
        string source FK "to Node"
        string target FK "to Node"
        boolean directed
        number length_km "km"
        integer capacity "see the network's assumptions"
        number avg_speed_kph "km/h"
        boolean fixed_open "optional"
        path geometry "optional"
    }
    Bridge {
        string id PK
        number lat "deg"
        number lon "deg"
        string edge FK "to Edge"
        number chainage_km "km, optional"
        string hazus_class
        number vs30 "m/s, optional"
        string vs30_source "optional"
    }
    GroundFailure {
        string id PK
        number lat "deg"
        number lon "deg"
        string edge FK "to Edge"
        number chainage_km "km, optional"
        string kind
        string road_class
        number length_km "km, optional"
        number x0 "optional"
        string liq_class "optional"
        number dw_km "km, optional"
        number slope_deg "deg, optional"
        number ac_g "g, optional"
        string slip_type "optional"
        string fault_id "optional"
    }
    Support {
        string id PK
        string origin FK "to Node"
        string source FK "to Node"
    }
    SystemEvent {
        string id PK "singleton: its variables are global"
        string analysis "optional"
        number target_add_h "h, optional"
        string description "optional"
    }
    Edge }o--|| Node : source
    Edge }o--|| Node : target
    Bridge }o--|| Edge : edge
    GroundFailure }o--|| Edge : edge
    Support }o--|| Node : origin
    Support }o--|| Node : source
```

## Quantities: the types on the links

| Quantity | Kind | Unit or states | Meaning | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PGA` | continuous | g | Peak ground acceleration | `fragility.bridge (in)`, `groundfailure.landslide (in)`, `groundfailure.liquefaction (in)`, `hazard.gmm (out)`, `hazard.shakemap (out)`, `hazard.shakemap.ground (out)` |
| `PGV` | continuous | cm/s | Peak ground velocity | `fragility.bridge (in)`, `groundfailure.landslide (in)`, `groundfailure.liquefaction (in)`, `hazard.gmm (out)`, `hazard.shakemap (out)`, `hazard.shakemap.ground (out)` |
| `SA(0.3)` | continuous | g | Spectral acceleration, T = 0.3 s, 5% damping | `fragility.bridge (in)`, `hazard.gmm (out)`, `hazard.shakemap (out)`, `hazard.shakemap.ground (out)` |
| `SA(1.0)` | continuous | g | Spectral acceleration, T = 1.0 s, 5% damping | `fragility.bridge (in)`, `hazard.gmm (out)`, `hazard.shakemap (out)`, `hazard.shakemap.ground (out)`, `observation.intensity (in)` |
| `SA(3.0)` | continuous | g | Spectral acceleration, T = 3.0 s, 5% damping | `fragility.bridge (in)`, `hazard.gmm (out)`, `hazard.shakemap (out)`, `hazard.shakemap.ground (out)` |
| `SAObs(1.0)` | continuous | g | Observed spectral acceleration, T = 1.0 s, 5% damping | `observation.intensity (out)` |
| `DamageState.HazusBridge` | discrete | none, slight, moderate, extensive, complete | Hazus highway-bridge damage state | `edge.open (in)`, `fragility.bridge (out)` |
| `PGD.Liquefaction` | continuous | m | Permanent ground displacement: liquefaction | `fragility.road (in)`, `groundfailure.liquefaction (out)` |
| `PGD.Landslide` | continuous | m | Permanent ground displacement: landslide | `fragility.road (in)`, `groundfailure.landslide (out)` |
| `PGD.FaultOffset` | continuous | m | Permanent ground displacement: fault crossing | `fragility.road (in)`, `hazard.fault-rupture (out)` |
| `RoadOpen.Liquefaction` | discrete | False, True | Road open at a liquefaction component | `edge.open (in)`, `fragility.road (out)` |
| `RoadOpen.Landslide` | discrete | False, True | Road open at a landslide component | `edge.open (in)`, `fragility.road (out)` |
| `RoadOpen.FaultRupture` | discrete | False, True | Road open at a fault crossing component | `edge.open (in)`, `fragility.road (out)` |
| `EdgeOpen` | discrete | False, True | Edge open to traffic | `edge.open (out)`, `system.reachable (in)`, `system.travel-time-to-nearest (in)` |
| `SystemState` | discrete | Fail, Survival | System event survives | `system.reachable (out)`, `system.travel-time-to-nearest (out)` |
